lines.t: Rejected
Undesired
Wounded deep
Where no one sees
They saw the surface
And chose another
But the eyes of God
Saw what they missed
You gave your all to win their heart
Still they looked the other way
Every hope that this time they'd love you
Left you empty day by day
Only One can fill the void
Only One can make you whole
Only One can heal all wounds
Only One God's Son
The world is loud
His voice is clear
Close your eyes
And plug your ears
When He saw you were unloved
When they said you're not good enough
He shed every tear you'd cry
Always there right by your side
They don't see you
But He does
Slow down
Be still
Leah longed for Jacob's heart
Gave him all, still stood apart
Living in her sister's shade
Every year the same old ache
With every child she hoped for love
Hoped that Jacob would see her too
But God saw her, God heard her
And the same God sees you too
The world is loud
His voice is clear
Close your eyes
And plug your ears
When He saw you were unloved
When they said you're not good enough
He shed every tear you'd cry
Always there right by your side
They don't see you
But He does
Slow down
Be still
The world says, "Prove you're good enough"
He says, "I loved you first, you are My love"
The world says, "You'll never compare"
He says, "I made you, I count every hair"
The world looks at the outward part
The Lord looks deep into the heart
This world will pass and fade away
His love for you is here to stay
This world will pass
His love will last
This world will pass
His love will last
He sees the heart, He sees it all
He knew your name before you were born
He sees you, and He calls you Mine
His love is the light that makes you shine
(He makes you shine)
His Word's a lamp, a light to see
His love is calling, "Come to Me"
So rest in Him
Let your heart be still
This time I will praise the Lord
Be still
When He saw you were unloved
When they said you're not good enough
He shed every tear you'd cry
Always there right by your side
In Him there is no dark at all
He hears you when you call
You are seen, He is enough
Be still
He sees you
He heals you
He is enough
Be still
